turns.transcript: Hi, this is Vonas Calling from Caffè Berlin.

We have a Marea 2 Plus, the Vaniglia edition. The coffee comes out in end fast, like water. Last year we ordered the group gasket, the code is GE-2140. GE-2140. We also need the shower screen, GE-TWO-150, for the heating element invoice size CA-1180. The control board is EL-8010, and the pump is ID-4010. The steam valve seal kit is VA-5015. Giglio 1 Plus enda a Monda 65 Digit grinder, the burrs are made just 70 ten.
Ende onda MB2 has a probe alarm.
